# Isaac-GR00T `cube_to_bowl_5` meta files

Copies of the `meta/` files of Isaac-GR00T's demo dataset, the comparison target for
`lib/export/lerobot.ts`. The tests in `tests/export/` assert that our `meta/` files carry
the same keys.

Fetched on 2026-10-23 from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T/main/demo_data/cube_to_bowl_5/meta/`:

- `info.json`
- `tasks.jsonl`
- `episodes.jsonl`
- `modality.json`
- `stats.json`

The demo ships no `episodes_stats.jsonl` (the URL returns 404). Isaac-GR00T is Apache-2.0.
